chunks: Safwan narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever dies and does not have a hady for his tamattuʿ, his guardian should fast on his behalf.

key_terms.هَدْيٌ: the sacrificial animal required in the context of tamattuʿ

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a person dies before offering the hady for tamattuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one performing tamattuʿ who dies before offering the required hady. In such a case, the guardian is instructed to fast on behalf of the deceased as a substitute obligation.
